([[North Royalton, Ohio]]) *[[MacDuffie School|MacDuffie]] ([[Granby, Massachusetts]]) *[[St. Thomas More School (Connecticut)|St. Thomas More]] ([[Oakdale, Connecticut]]) | college = [[Villanova Wildcats men's basketball|Villanova]] (2017–2018) | draft_year = | draft_round = | draft_pick = | draft_team = | highlights = * [[List of NCAA Men's Division I Basketball champions|NCAA champion]] ([[2018 NCAA Men's Division I Basketball Tournament|2018]]) * [[Big East Conference Men's Basketball Rookie of the Year|Big East Rookie of the Year]] (2018) *[[Jordan Brand Classic]] (2016) }} '''Omari Spellman''' (born July 21, 1997) is an American [[basketball]] player. He played college basketball for the [[Villanova Wildcats men's basketball|Villanova Wildcats]]. He won a national championship with Villanova in 2018. ==Early life and high school career== Spellman was born in [[Cleveland, Ohio]]. Spellman began 9th grade at [[Middletown High School (New York)|Middletown High School]] in New York but tranferred to [[Hoosac School]] after two to three months, but had to start in 8th grade there.{{cite news|last1=Tydings|first1=Stephen|title=Jay Wright on Omari Spellman ruling: 'I'm argued out'|url=http://www.nbcsports.com/philadelphia/ncaa/villanova-basketball-jay-wright-omari-spellman-argued-out|accessdate=March 31, 2018|work=[[NBC Sports]]|date=September 23, 2016}} Spellman later attended [[North Royalton High School]] in [[North Royalton, Ohio]]. As a sophomore, he averaged 22 points per game and 9.8 rebounds a game for the Bears. Before the start of his Junior year, Spellman decided to attend the [[MacDuffie School]] in [[Granby, Massachusetts]]. Spellman played his senior season at [[St. Thomas More School (Connecticut)|St. Thomas More]] in [[Montville, Connecticut]]. As a senior in 2015-16, he averaged 16 points and seven rebounds per game. Despite not being named an [[McDonald's All-American]], Spellman was selected to play in the 2016 [[Jordan Brand Classic]] where He had a double-double of 12 points and 15 rebounds. Spellman was rated as a five-star recruit and considered a top-15 player of the 2016 high school class. He was ranked the No. 16 overall player in the 2016 ESPN Top 100 and No. 5 among power forwards.{{cite web|title=14 Omari Spellman|url=http://www.villanova.com/sports/m-baskbl/mtt/omari_spellman_1029432.html|website=[[Villanova Wildcats]]|accessdate=March 31, 2018}} He played AAU ball for the PSA Cardinals and wrote poetry as a downtime activity.{{cite news|last1=Borzello|first1=Jeff|title=How Omari Spellman became the perfect final piece in Villanova's Final Four puzzle|url=http://www.espn.com/mens-college-basketball/story/_/id/22956033/2018-ncaa-tournament-omari-spellman-final-piece-villanova-wildcats-final-four-return|accessdate=March 31, 2018|work=[[ESPN]]|date=March 30, 2016}} ==College career== [[File:Villanova Parade 2018 04.jpg|file|thumb|right|250px|[[Eric Paschall]], [[Donte DiVincenzo]], Spellman, [[Collin Gillespie]], and [[Jalen Brunson]].]] Spellman was forced to redshirt his freshman year as a partial academic qualifier since he did not graduate with his original high school class. He broke down in tears when this was first announced but was more composed after the appeal process failed. In his redshirt year, he slimmed down from 300 lbs. to 245 lbs and focused on eating healthier. As a redshirt freshman, Spellman shoots a team-high 44.6 percent from behind the arc. Spellman had a season-high 27 points in an 87-67 rout of [[Temple Owls men's basketball|Temple]] on December 13.{{cite news|title=Brunson leads No. 1 Villanova in rout of Temple|url=http://www.espn.com/mens-college-basketball/recap?gameId=400988008|accessdate=March 31, 2018|work=[[ESPN]]|agency=[[Associated Press]]|date=December 13, 2017}} He had 18-points, eight rebounds and three blocks in the Sweet 16 matchup against [[West Virginia Mountaineers men's basketball|West Virginia]].{{cite news|last1=Serby|first1=Steve|title=Villanova big man knows exactly how to beat Kansas’ beast|url=https://nypost.com/2018/03/31/villanova-big-man-knows-exactly-how-to-beat-kansas-beast/|accessdate=March 31, 2018|work=[[New York Post]]|date=March 31, 2018}} ==References== {{reflist}} ==External links== *[http://www.espn.com/mens-college-basketball/player/_/id/4065836/omari-spellman ESPN profile] {{2018 Villanova Wildcats men's basketball navbox}} {{DEFAULTSORT:Spellman, Omari}} [[Category:1997 births]] [[Category:Living people]] [[Category:African-American basketball players]] [[Category:Basketball players at the 2018 NCAA Men's Division I Final Four]] [[Category:Basketball players from Ohio]] [[Category:Power forwards (basketball)]] [[Category:Sportspeople from Cleveland]] [[Category:Villanova Wildcats men's basketball players]]
